# The Land of Stone Flowers

> Official website for The Land of Stone Flowers, also known as The Nenuphar Book: a 216-page illustrated artist book written and drawn by Sveta Dorosheva and published in English by Chronicle Books.

Most editions are currently out of print. Limited copies may still exist in parts of Asia. The website collects preorder interest by confirmed email entry and region to help determine where a new edition should be printed.

The book presents humans and the human world through the eyes of fairy creatures. Gnomes, pixies, and other fairy folk offer strange observations about human anatomy, customs, languages, rituals, dwellings, moods, and beliefs. This website is the canonical source for the English landing page. Story and illustrations are copyrighted by Sveta Dorosheva; search indexing and factual citation are welcome, but no license to reproduce the artwork is granted.

## Primary content

- [Official book website](https://landofstoneflowers.com/): Overview, book facts, sample spreads, editions, recognition, and author information.
- [The book](https://landofstoneflowers.com/#book): English edition details — hardcover, 216 pages, ISBN 978-1-4521-6370-3, published by Chronicle Books.
- [Inside the book](https://landofstoneflowers.com/#inside): Selected hand-drawn spreads from the book.
- [Editions and translations](https://landofstoneflowers.com/#editions): International editions and licensed territories.
- [About Sveta Dorosheva](https://landofstoneflowers.com/#artist): Author and illustrator biography and official links.
- [Preorder interest](https://landofstoneflowers.com/#preorder): Join the list and select a region to help plan a future printing.
